purpose: Test a smaller generation task with one source anchor and one proposed complete test per call. This is a joint task-grain/context experiment, not a pure cost ablation.

policy.purpose: Joint generation task-grain/context experiment; not a pure cost ablation.
policy.anchors: At most the first three distinct already-prepared R18 anchors, in their frozen order. No omitted-anchor recovery or repetition.
policy.context: Identical public issue/API catalog plus one COMPLETE existing anchor context bundle. Helpers and source controls within that bundle remain intact.
policy.output: Zero or one complete body rewrite per fixed slot; original R18 boundary decoder and fresh full-test review.
policy.ordering: Slot 1 over all sorted trials, then slot 2, then slot 3. Missing anchors remain ledger entries.
policy.duplicate: Keep the earliest exact source-bound complete program per trial; retain later duplicate slots and their cost. No refill.
policy.generation_inputs: Only sealed R18 preparation, requests and source contexts; never its generation responses, decisions, audits or native outcomes.
policy.review: Reuse R18 fresh candidate source enrichment, whole-test review, complete original controls and first failure plus one repeat.

semantic_policy.ordering: original slot ranks round robin over sorted trial names
semantic_policy.unknown: not executed; not an invalid-test judgment

comparative_limits: At most four editable original anchors per trial; complete contexts can contain extra original control tests.
The 24000-byte issue API catalog shares the 96000-byte budget with complete seed contexts.
Body-only generation retains registration, signatures, decorators and imports.
Original issue descriptions already contain rich semantic targets; these contracts are also available to this direct baseline.
Python requires complete AST value transport; Go and TypeScript retain the existing syntax transport and its documented limits.
Source selection, budget omissions and missing contracts limit a negative result. It cannot establish superiority over unrestricted direct models.
Joint task-grain/context experiment, not a pure cost ablation: separate calls alter independent reasoning budget and overhead.
At most three DISTINCT already-prepared R18 anchors; never retrieve omitted anchors or repeat an anchor.
All three slots per trial remain in the ledger. Empty/unknown/refused/duplicate/budget-withheld slots are not refilled.
Fresh review retains the same R18 candidate-specific original-source enrichment and complete-test transport.
The 1M generation cap does not guarantee all45 requests; actual and reserved usage govern stopping.

tests.scope: 17 new atomic-ledger tests plus51 unchanged R18/core/transport regressions

development_sequence: Motivated by the first two R18 length-truncated responses; no R18 native results existed. Generation inputs contain only sealed R18 preparation and original source contexts.
native_interface_plan: Use the separately frozen provenance-only native bridge after fresh semantic review. Preserve all proposal code/IDs/ranks and raw generation/review evidence; add only verified source metadata. Do not attempt the known broken original emission interface.
semantic_interpretation: Model-supported decisions require controlled native execution and independent full-test source audit. Three candidates lack a complete usable review; these are unknown, not invalid tests.

native_bridge.source_policy: Provenance-only bridge algorithm frozen at 2e6fce8. Complete proposal programs, IDs, ranks, original review decisions and raw costs unchanged. All 17 trials retained.
native_bridge.chronology: Preparation sealed exact candidates and algorithm before native dispatch. The attempted research metadata update failed because it assumed a nonexistent prepare_validation.json; the chained shell-tool orchestration nevertheless dispatched native. This record is saved after dispatch. Do not describe its git commit as pre-execution preregistration. Core and bridge algorithms were already frozen; no code or policy changed.
